page.overview:
Who is Admiral?

The Admiral, known as Anacis in the Japanese version, is a man who travels the sea in a submarine and docks at Duel Academy. Arrogant and ambitious, he believes that everything (and everyone) in the world can be bought with money.

The Admiral challenges Jaden Yuki to a Duel, the latter at first thinking he was one of the Shadow Riders because the microphone feedback obscured Umi no Duel (Duel of the Sea) into Yami no Duel (Duel of Darkness) and due to his interest in the Sacred Beasts. Chazz Princeton, Bastion Misawa, and Alexis Rhodes accompanied Jaden onto the ship to see what kind of a Duelist the Admiral was while Syrus Truesdale refused after having gotten into a fight with Jaden. Halfway through their Duel, the Admiral offers Jaden a position in his new Duel Academy under the sea. When Jaden rejects the offer, he places a bet on the outcome of the Duel. Even though he ultimately loses, the Admiral kidnaps Jaden who isn't seen until three days later (in the dub, it was one week), riding on a motorboat and claiming to have escaped when the Admiral wasn't looking.

In the English dub, the Admiral speaks in a stereotypical pirate voice, using phrases such as "Shiver me timbers!", in addition to making references to "doubloons" and "booty", which confuses several characters. In the original version, he ends his sentences with cchuu, roughly equating to "I say."

Admiral plays a Deepsea Deck based around the Field Spell Card "A Legendary Ocean" and focuses on Summoning powerful monsters such as "Levia-Dragon Daedalus".
